jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description:
About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

  • Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

  • Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

  • Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

  • Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

  • Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

  • Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

  • Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

  • Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

  • Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

  • Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

  • Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

  • AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

  • Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

  • At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

  • Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working in a large, established codebase

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

  • Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

  • Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

  • High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

  • Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

  • Temporal or another durable workflow engine

  • React Native

  • Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

  • Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

  • Open-source work or internal tools that other people use

If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

Location and employment

This is a full-time employee role, remote and based in Toronto, Ontario. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications for this role.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardineâs platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location: Remote - India
To be considered for this position, you must reside in one of the following cities:

  • Karnataka: Bangalore/Bengaluru

  • Delhi: Delhi

  • Harayana: Gurugram

  • Chennai: Chennai

  • Maharashtra: Mumbai

  • Maharashtra: Pune

About the Role:

As a backend-focused Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, constructing,

and maintaining APIs, services, and systems across our engineering team. This multifaceted

position involves developing new features on a large scale, refining internal tooling and

processes, contributing to product and technical roadmaps, and assuming diverse

responsibilities within the organization. The ideal candidate for the backend role will have a

proven track record in building highly available APIs, with additional proficiency in data pipelines and the relevant domain.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, create, and maintain robust, efficient, and reliable backend services to meet our platform's evolving needs.

  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to architect and implement new services from inception to delivery.

  • Contribute to developing new features and capabilities that deliver substantial value to our customers.

  • Work with various engineering and product teams to synchronize efforts and deliver cutting-edge solutions.

  • Craft and maintain user-facing technical documentation, enhancing user understanding and facilitating seamless adoption of our services.

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping our company's engineering culture, ensuring the maintenance of high engineering standards across the organization.

What youâll need:

  • 7+ years of proven experience as a Software Engineer specializing in web backend development.

  • Proficiency in Golang is a significant advantage.

  • Additional experience in data engineering is highly desirable.

  • A track record of successfully delivering high-quality production services and systems.

  • Customer-centric approach with a strong emphasis on empathy towards users.

  • Relevant industry experience, particularly in banking or fintech, and domain knowledge in fraud prevention or compliance.

  • Proficient in English - from casual chats to formal reports.

Technologies we use:

  • Golang

  • Ruby

  • TypeScript (React + node)

  • Bigtable

  • Postgres / PostgreSQL

  • GCP dataflow (apache beam)

  • BigQuery

  • Python

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office â desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (United States)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team. You will be the technical authority embedded with our most complex customers, guiding them through deployment, architecture, onboarding, and the adoption of agentic development workflows. You bring deep hands-on experience from prior roles and use that depth to advise, design repeatable patterns, and drive customer outcomes end to end. You operate autonomously, own the technical success of your customers, and bring their experience back to shape how Coder builds and delivers.

This is not an execution-only role. You are equally comfortable doing deep technical work with a customer and stepping back to design the repeatable pattern behind it. You are energized by ambiguity, motivated by customer outcomes, and capable of influencing organizational change alongside the technical work.

Â 

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary technical authority for post-sales customers, guiding deployment architecture, environment design, and adoption of Coder across both human and AI development workflows

  • Own onboarding engagements end to end, ensuring customers move from contract to productive adoption with speed and confidence

  • Lead Get Well engagements where architecture decisions, rollout patterns, or organizational dynamics are limiting customer health or growth

  • Help customers implement the technical and organizational changes required to adopt agentic development practices at scale

  • Design and document repeatable delivery patterns across onboarding, architecture, and adoption that can scale across customer segments

  • Design and recommend reference architectures tailored to each customer's cloud environment, security posture, and organizational constraints

  • Translate customer environment complexity into clear guidance on networking, ingress, identity, and infrastructure patterns

  • Anticipate technical and operational risks, escalate to the right internal stakeholders, and track issues through to resolution

  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture guides, how-to resources, and statements of work that extend your impact across the customer base

  • Capture structured product feedback from customer deployments and advocate directly with engineering and product teams for roadmap and usability improvements

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years of experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineering, or equivalent post-sales technical role, with a demonstrated track record of guiding enterprise customers through complex technical deployments

  • Proven hands-on experience from a prior role designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major provider: AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure; you have done the work and can speak to it with specificity

  • 2+ years experience deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in an enterprise context

  • Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security or compliance stakeholder

  • 2 or more years of production experience with Kubernetes: cluster design, workload scheduling, networking, storage, and operational lifecycle

  • 2 or more years of experience with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling; you understand how enterprise teamsâ structure, version, and maintain IaC at scale

  • Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, including networking fundamentals: ingress controllers, proxies, load balancers, and DNS resolution in cloud-native environments

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps practices; you understand how code moves from commit to running workload in an enterprise context

  • Working knowledge of cloud security and identity: IAM patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, and compliance-relevant controls

  • Understanding of observability practices including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems

  • Demonstrated ability to design repeatable delivery patterns, not just solve one-off problems

  • Comfort working through organizational and workflow change alongside technical change with customers

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills: you can hold a room with a senior infrastructure team and produce a clear architecture document without those being separate skills

  • High customer empathy: you understand that the best technical solution does not always fit a customer's constraints, timeline, or organizational reality

  • Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy in a startup environment

Â 

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Experience at both early-stage startups and larger software organizations

  • Background as a Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Platform Engineer before moving into a customer-facing role

  • Familiarity with regulated environments: air-gapped deployments, network isolation, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or DORA requirements

  • Experience with disaster recovery design and multi-region availability patterns

  • Cloud cost optimization experience, including rightsizing, reserved capacity, and FinOps practices

  • Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS)

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience with Backstage.io or similar internal developer portals and platform tooling

  • Prior work on or alongside a developer platform or platform engineering team

  • Experience introducing new operating models or delivery patterns across post-sales or go-to-market teams

  • Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview processÂ 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby and Brainerr help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact careers@coder.com.

Â 

Coder is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Loopio is on the hunt for a Senior Software Developer with an AI engineering background who thrives on solving complex problems and is driven by curiosity. If you have taken LLM-based systems from idea to production and want your work to help leading organizations respond to RFPs faster and with more confidence, this is the role for you.

Youâll join a team of Engineers, ML practitioners, Product Managers, and Designers to design and ship AI-powered features, from agentic workflows that reason over long and messy documents to the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. At Loopio, we value clean code, evidence-driven decisions, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. From shaping technical direction to mentoring teammates, youâll play a key role in scaling our systems and evolving our product.

Weâre deeply collaborative. Whether itâs pair programming, technical design reviews, error-analysis sessions, or whiteboarding ideas, we believe the best solutions are built together. What Youâll Be Doing:

  • Owning problems end to end, from zero. You take an idea or problem through framing, a research plan, build, validation, shipping, and monitoring, and you make fast, honest pursue-or-kill calls along the way.

  • Designing, building, and shipping LLM-based and agentic systems (tool use, multi-step workflows) that plan and execute work over long or messy documents, including layout-aware parsing, extraction, classification, and cross-document reasoning.

  • Partnering closely with the ML team to turn research prototypes into reliable, maintainable features in a shared codebase with a proper test harness and CI workflow, including knowledge-graph-grounded retrieval where it fits.

  • Building evaluation into everything you ship: eval sets and regression suites, at both the task level and the step level, that predict production behavior for single models and multi-step pipelines alike.

  • Digging into the data before modeling, and running systematic error analysis when results fall short. You judge whether a problem demands precision, recall, or coverage, because a missed question costs the customer and a wrong suggestion costs trust.

  • Going below the API when it makes sense: training, fine-tuning, or distilling models, and surveying the research literature to adapt what you find to the problem at hand.

  • Operating AI features live, including tracing, failure triage, and managing cost and latency tradeoffs.

  • Contributing to Loopioâs AI roadmap by evaluating third-party models, establishing patterns for agentic workflows, and defining technical and evaluation guidelines for AI-powered features.

  • Designing and shipping reusable frameworks and shared libraries that raise the bar for how every team at Loopio builds, so good patterns scale instead of being reinvented.

  • Interacting with and gathering detailed feedback from our customers, because you understand that creating a user-centric experience comes first.

  • Explaining tradeoffs, metrics, and failure modes to product and engineering partners in plain language, with write-ups that let others follow your reasoning and act on your results.

  • Mentoring and coaching others, providing technical guidance and helping build an environment of knowledge-sharing and encouraging feedback.

  • Comfortably leading technical design discussions and facilitating technical decision making. Experience as a technical lead is a bonus!

What Youâll Bring To The Team:

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software systems at scale.

  • Experience applying NLP to messy real-world documents: parsing, chunking, extraction, and classification.

  • Rigor in research and evaluation. You look at the data before modeling, let evidence drive decisions, run systematic error analysis when results fall short, and build eval sets and regression suites that predict production behavior.

  • The ability to own problems end to end, from zero, and to make fast, honest pursue-or-kill calls.

  • Comfort surveying research literature and adapting what you find to the problem at hand.

  • Strong Python and solid engineering habits: your prototypes become maintainable systems in a shared codebase, test harness, and CI workflow. Backend/API development experience in Java or PHP is also welcome.

  • Experience designing and consuming scalable RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party systems, and a strong understanding of database design and RDBMS such as MySQL or similar.

  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and core services (e.g., EC2, RDS, S3, VPC, ECS/Fargate, and Lambda) to build, deploy, and scale resilient cloud-native applications.

  • Clear communication. You explain a tradeoff, a metric, or a failure mode to product and engineering partners in plain language.

  • Mentorship of other engineers through coaching, design, and code reviews, and a growing passion for improving software development productivity for your team.

  • Strong candidates may also have experience with document-understanding agentic workflows: agents that plan and execute multi-step work over long or messy documents, task-level and step-level evaluation using curated document test sets, and operating these systems live (tracing, failure triage, cost and latency tradeoffs).

  • Experience in the following is a plus: semantic search, RAG, and knowledge-graph-grounded retrieval, Elasticsearch, Databricks, React and TypeScript, and Cypress.
